verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing, payments, and ledger platform-as-a-service accessed via a GraphQL API and SDKs. It is not an AI agent or host application that would act as an MCP client and consume other servers' tools, so this client-side story does not apply to its product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an MCP-client or tool-plugin capability; its agentic-commerce material is about issuing cards to external agents, not consuming MCP tools.
